== English Special Edition comparison ==
The 12 March 2016 Players Committee announcement changes a capital starship to your capital starship. The June 2017 slip repeats that change and still calls the site Central Core. The 2023 rulebook uses the full title Death Star: Central Core for the same site. The Holotable face follows the 2017 wording.
